    Teacher setup

    Set things up here, then click Download classroom copy at the bottom. That copy has your images and your Google Sheet link built in. It's the file to give students.

    1. Artwork images

    Images load from Wikimedia Commons, which some school networks block. The classroom copy has every image built in, so it works offline and on any network. If a painting shows “didn’t load,” upload your own image for it.

    2. Collect critiques in a Google Sheet (optional)

    Each time a student unlocks a gate, their critique is added as a row in your Sheet. One-time setup, about 5 minutes:

    1. Create a new Google Sheet. Open Extensions › Apps Script.
    2. Delete what's there, paste the script below, and click Save.
    3. Click Deploy › New deployment. For type, pick Web app.
    4. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Anyone, then Deploy and approve the permissions.
    5. Copy the Web app URL, paste it below, and click Send test row.

    “Anyone” only lets the game add rows. Nobody can read your Sheet through this link. Students should still download their critiques as a backup.

    3. Teacher password

    Set a password so students can’t open Teacher setup in the classroom copy. Only the classroom copy asks for it. This file always opens freely, so if you forget the password, set a new one here and download a new classroom copy.
